# nemau load-balancer instance

Manage load balancers.

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer instance [command]
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create](nemau_load-balancer_instance_create.md) | Create a load balancer |
| [delete](nemau_load-balancer_instance_delete.md) | Delete a load balancer |
| [get](nemau_load-balancer_instance_get.md) | Show one load balancer |
| [list](nemau_load-balancer_instance_list.md) | List the load balancers |
| [update](nemau_load-balancer_instance_update.md) | Change a load balancer's name or description |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
